If you do, that unit is split into two units, each containing as equal a number of models as possible (when splitting a unit in this way, make a note of which models form each of the two new units]. One of these units must start the battle embarked within this model; the other can start the battle embarked within another TRANSPORT, or it can be deployed as a separate unit."
